name: Greenish Teal
lede: Greenish Teal is a bright sea green named by modifier grammar as greenish plus [[teal]], recorded by the 2010 xkcd color survey.

sections.title: Greenish, plus teal
sections.body:
Our data classes Greenish Teal as a crowd modifier name, the word greenish pushing the parent color [[teal]] away from blue [1]. Like most xkcd-survey compounds, it carries no deeper history than the 2010 online survey that collected it; our sources name no earlier dictionary or pigment list for this exact value [1]. Our library files it as an alternate name of [[imperial-green|Imperial Green]], 3.9 units away [1].

The swatch is not teal. Teal is a dark blue-green, while this survey value is a light, clear green with only a hint of blue [1]. Its nearest named look-alikes are Imperial Green and [[mountain-meadow|Mountain Meadow]], both at 3.9 units, with [[caribbean-green|Caribbean Green]] at 4.5 and [[emerald|Emerald]] at 5.3 [2].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive carries a color within six units of this one over at least five percent of its canvas, as photographed [3]. That says more about this collection of photographed, varnished museum paintings than about what greens painters could mix [3].

questions.q: Greenish Teal's name is built from which two pieces?
True or false: the Greenish Teal swatch is a dark blue-green like teal itself.

openers: Despite its name, Greenish Teal is a clear, light green, nearer emerald than the dark blue-green of teal.
